title: Clannad: After Story

alternative_titles.ja: CLANNAD〜AFTER STORY〜 クラナド アフターストーリー

synopsis:
Tomoya Okazaki and Nagisa Furukawa have graduated from high school, and together, they experience the emotional rollercoaster of growing up. Unable to decide on a course for his future, Tomoya learns the value of a strong work ethic and discovers the strength of Nagisa's support. Through the couple's dedication and unity of purpose, they push forward to confront their personal problems, deepen their old relationships, and create new bonds.

Time also moves on in the Illusionary World. As the plains grow cold with the approach of winter, the Illusionary Girl and the Garbage Doll are presented with a difficult situation that reveals the World's true purpose.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: A Farewell to the End of Summer
episodes_data.description: Tomoya and his girlfriend Nagisa end summer vacation by helping out with a neighborhood shopping district baseball game. Things don`t go smoothly for the team.

episodes_data.title: In Search of False Love
episodes_data.description: Nagisa is worried about Mei`s lack of focus. Mei comes to stay with Nagisa, and Tomoya thinks it`s a good idea introduce Youhei to the ladies.

episodes_data.title: Hearts Out of Synch
episodes_data.description: Youhei and Sanae enjoy a date together, but Mei still has her doubts about her brother and stalks the date.

episodes_data.title: With the Same Smile as That Day
episodes_data.description: Worried about Youhei`s absence from school, Tomoya investigates and discovers that he quit the soccer team due to bullying. Trouble sparks when the soccer team picks on Mei.

episodes_data.title: The Season You Were There
episodes_data.description: Misae remembers a strange boy she met when she was in high school, Katsuki. She gears up to tell her crush, Igarashi, about her crush on him, only to face a heartbreak.

episodes_data.title: Forever by Your Side
episodes_data.description: Misae begins to spend more time with Katsuki. Just as she realizes her feelings for him, Katsuki`s revelation prevents them from being together.

episodes_data.title: Where She Belongs
episodes_data.description: Tomoya and Nagisa discover that Yukine is beloved by two rival gangs for her part as a healer. Their involvement with her case may put them in the crosshairs of one gang.

episodes_data.title: A Courageous Battle
episodes_data.description: Yukine and Tomoya try to de-escalate tensions between the two gangs before the police get involved, and Tomoya may have to go to great lengths to bring peace.

episodes_data.title: Along the Path
episodes_data.description: Graduation approaches! The group discusses their plans for the future, but Nagisa`s sickness returns, forcing her to miss exams.

episodes_data.title: A Season of Beginnings
episodes_data.description: Tomoya takes a job at a bakery, hoping to become more independent while Nagisa returns to school and tries to revive the theater club.

episodes_data.title: The Founder's Day Festival Promise
episodes_data.description: Tomoya struggles to find his stride at his new job, and his responsibilities take its toll on his relationship with Nagisa.

episodes_data.title: A Sudden Happening
episodes_data.description: Yuusuke shares some of his painful past with Tomoya. Later, Tomoya`s promotion falls through as a result of his father`s misconduct.

episodes_data.title: Graduation
episodes_data.description: Tomoya wants Akio to accept his future marriage to Nagisa. Months later, the group prepares to celebrate Nagisa`s long-awaited graduation.

episodes_data.title: A New Family
episodes_data.description: Now a happily married couple, Nagisa and Tomoya start to find their stride in life together. The two are worried that their old school will be turn down and move to save it.

episodes_data.title: In the Remains of Summer
episodes_data.description: A pregnant Nagisa is spending more time in bed, weak with morning sickness. Tomoya is worried about her health, but Nagisa tries to assure him.

episodes_data.title: White Darkness
episodes_data.description: In the latter part of her pregnancy, Nagisa has become sick again and goes into premature labor. Due to the snow, she is unable to be taken to the hospital.

episodes_data.title: Summer Time
episodes_data.description: Five years later, Tomoya is a workaholic who spends his money on drinking and smoking. Sanae tricks him into being alone with Ushio, but he can`t seem to connect with her.

episodes_data.title: The Ends of the Earth
episodes_data.description: Ushio accidentally loses a toy robot Tomoya bought for her and searches for it. Tomoya comes to an understanding about his relationship with his father and his daughter.

episodes_data.title: The Road Home
episodes_data.description: After returning from their trip, Tomoya finally takes Ushio home to live with him, permanently. The two meet up with old friends.

episodes_data.title: The Mischievous Sea Breeze
episodes_data.description: Ushio`s teacher in school is none other than Kyou. Tomoya asks Fuko to play with Ushio as he gets ready to participate in the school`s sports day.

episodes_data.title: The End of the World
episodes_data.description: At discovering that Ushio has the same sickness that took Nagisa, Tomoya drops everything to take care of her. As time passes, Tomoya prepares to grant Ushio`s wish.

episodes_data.title: A Small Hand
episodes_data.description: Sitting on the hill, Tomoya calls out to Nagisa, who appears and brings him back through time to see what their life could have been.

specials_data.title: Events from a Year Ago
specials_data.description: Tomoya looks back on his past in his second year of high school. Nagisa has trouble making friends, and Tomoya and Youhei are pranking Kyou.

specials_data.title: Under the Green Tree
specials_data.description: Tomoya tells his daughter the story of his life with Nagisa and how Ushio was born, but with a happier ending.

specials_data.title: Another World: Kyou Arc
specials_data.description: Tomoya explores the life he could have had as Ushio falls asleep while he tells her the story of his mother`s past.
